description: Figure 4 illustrates the mean absolute values of sparsity ratios before and after gating, with the baseline and post-gating values being similar. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 20, and the y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. The line plot includes three lines: a solid line representing the sparsity ratio before gating, a dashed line representing the sparsity ratio after gating, and a dash-dot line representing the average sparsity ratio after gating. The solid line starts at a value of 0.03 and decreases to a value of 0.03, indicating a slight decrease in sparsity ratio after gating. The dashed line starts at a value of 0.03 and decreases to a value of 0.126, indicating a more significant decrease in sparsity ratio after gating. The dash-dot line starts at a value of 0.03 and decreases to a value of 0.126, indicating a similar decrease in sparsity ratio after gating as the dashed line.
